ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio approximately 85% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels to 15% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white background. Low-intensity black continuous banding along the trailing edge. High-contrast, localized circular and annular black blobs distributed stochastically across the surface with higher density in the distal regions of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center-point of the fluke lobes with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrated boundary with pixel-amplitude peaks of 5-12 pixels along the continuous linear boundary, particularly jagged towards the outer tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature observed on the leading/lower edges sweeping outwards and upwards from the peduncle insertion to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of localized, roughly circular/annular high-contrast dark pixel clusters (rosette-pattern) scattered across both lobes; primary cluster constellation visible on the upper half of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct vertical low-intensity linear disruption (streak) on the right lobe near the notch; several faint diagonal linear marks on the right distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (likely barnacle-induced) and severe irregularity/jaggedness along the trailing edge indicative of significant tissue wear.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent vertical dark pixel streak located immediately to the right of the median notch.
